title: Muscatine, Iowa dance and learning square-dance music
summary: At a big dance in Muscatine the crowd preferred the other band's quadrille music, so Desvigne bought a book of that music and rehearsed it.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: They didn't want that kind of music. Yeah, we played in- In- Muscatine, Iowa. Yeah.

I have 11 men in the band, and it's a big dance. And we had some guy by the name of Slim John or something. He played the accordion, that hillbilly stuff, you know. So we had an hour to play, and they would play an hour. So we started off playing our first hour. People were all crowded around the place, but nobody wouldn't dance. The kind of stuff we were putting out, they just didn't like that. So after our hour was up, and this band played, boy, the first number they hit, one of them old quadrille, little square dancers or something, and everybody got up and started dancing. So you know what I did the next day? I went to the music store and bought me a whole book of that kind of stuff that that band was putting on. We were rehearsing the whole day. And boy, when we started playing it, everybody danced in. We had them. We had them covered.
